newsitem.title: MEXICO: Banco de Mexico okays dollar put secondary market.
newsitem.headline: Banco de Mexico okays dollar put secondary market.

text.p: Banco de Mexico has authorized a secondary market for dollar put options that it auctions each months to local banks, a statement said on Wednesday.
A central bank circular issued to banks said it was modifying the auction system "to enable institutions that win dollar put options in the auction to sell them to their clients."
It added that the puts also could be sold totally or partially to other banks.
Banco de Mexico said the secondary sale should be reported by the put seller to the central bank, including the amount involved and the name of the counter-party.
The amount sold should be $1 million or multiples thereof.
The central bank has raised the amount of puts it plans to sell in September to $200 million from $130 million, because of the success of the first auction.
